name: Vikings
startIntroPart1: We are the Vikings. we are a fishermen, hunters and warriors. We are well known as coastal raiders.
declaringWar: We come from the midst of the sea and none are able to withstand us.
attacked: Your attack on us will be your death
neutralHello: We sail the mighty seas looking for plunder.
hateHello: The seas are ours! Stay out of the waters.
uniques: Enables [Water] units to enter ocean tiles

name: Saxons
startIntroPart1: The Saxonx greet you. We have inhabitanted this country for centuries. We have had many long-lived city-states spread throughout this land.
declaringWar: We will tear out thy foundations and destroy thy people.
attacked: You dare besiege us! We will go forth to battle and defeat you!
defeated: We bow to thee who has destroyed our vast army.
neutralHello: Our greatness will not compare with you but welcome.
uniques: Gain control over [8] tiles [in this city] <upon founding a city>
